verdict.rationale:
Postman docs show the CLI/API can run collections unattended as part of CI/CD pipelines (postman-docs-6, postman-docs-19, postman-docs-32), which supports automations executing without a human present, but there is no evidence of a dedicated scheduler/monitor or autonomous agent that runs tasks in the background outside of a triggered pipeline context. Agent Mode (postman-docs-8) is described as an interactive natural-language assistant, not a background autonomous runner.
missing for 10: explicit scheduling/monitor feature for unattended recurring runs, evidence of a persistent background agent that acts without a CI/CD trigger, independent/hands-on confirmation of autonomous execution.
